flags_for_lead: Topstep's 2026 holiday table (reports/stage_e0_topstep_facts.md F12.3) sets 'Close Positions By 11:45 CT' on MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day and Thanksgiving, and 12:00 CT on the day after Thanksgiving and Christmas Eve, without naming products. CME's FX session runs to 16:00 CT on those Monday holidays and Thanksgiving and to 13:45/12:45 CT on the two early-close days (the Friday holidays, Juneteenth and Independence Day 2026, agree: FX closes 12:00 CT). Whether Topstep's blanket cutoffs bind FX is a rules question (D9.1), not a calendar one; this calendar records CME's hours only.

The 2022+ regular-hours FX holidays have no settlement and CME books them to the next trade date. They are not calendar entries (their session clock is the regular one); if a member or the rules engine needs to know that a day is a US holiday (for example for settlement-based logic), NO_ENTRY_FINDINGS lists them.

LATE_OPENS (2025-11-28, reopen 07:30 CT) is an unscheduled outage recorded by CME's own service data, added as an additive extension; the lead decides whether the bar builder uses it. On that day D6's O (07:20) precedes the reopen.
